title: Welcome to CAD Champions
purpose: Four short screens so you know how this works and which software to train in. It takes about a minute.
skipHelp: You can finish this later from your dashboard. Nothing is lost.

what.title: What CAD Champions is
what.body: CAD Champions is training for the national CAD skills competition, made by Gestaltung360, a digital fabrication studio in Lusail.
what.point1Text: You take one test. It shows where you stand in six skill areas.
what.point2Text: Your results decide what to practise first, so you do not waste time.
what.point3Text: The tasks follow the same kind of work you will be asked to do on competition day.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Four steps, in this order. Each one unlocks the next.
how.getReadyText: Check your computer and software, then do a short practice upload.
how.testText: Build the parts in your CAD software and upload the files.
how.resultsText: See your score and level in each skill area.
how.trainingText: Follow lessons and exercises that start where you are.
how.testHelp: A diagnostic test. It is not pass or fail. It only measures your skills so we can plan your training.

before.title: Before the test
before.intro: You do not need to prepare anything today. Here is what you will need when you take the test:
before.computerText: A Windows PC is best. Mac users can use Autodesk Fusion.
before.softwareText: Software that can save a <step>STEP file</step>, such as Inventor, Fusion or SOLIDWORKS.
before.timeText: Once the timer starts, it keeps running. Pick a time when nobody will interrupt you.
before.guide: The Get Ready page will guide you through all of this, step by step.

software.title: Choose your training software
software.intro: This decides which videos and examples you see in training.
software.switchNote: You can switch later in settings. Your test can be done in any software.
software.inventorSuits: Best choice for the competition. The tasks are built on Inventor.
software.fusionSuits: For Mac users and schools that use Fusion. Also allowed at EuroSkills.
software.solidworksSuits: For students who already work in SOLIDWORKS.
software.solidworksNote: The competition uses Autodesk Inventor or Fusion. The SOLIDWORKS track builds the same skills, and we recommend switching to Inventor before competition mocks.

errors.saveTitle: We could not save your choice
errors.saveBody: Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, tap Need help? and we will sort it out.
errors.skipTitle: We could not skip right now
errors.skipBody: Please try again in a moment.
